director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?
samajh nahi aaya
Aaj hum kisi shape ke chaaron taraf ka poora kinaara naapenge. Chalo, shuru karein?
samajh nahi aaya

Yahi sabse seedha tareeka hai jo mere paas hai, koi baat nahi. Cricket pitch ke kinaare ek kone se chalo aur wahin lauto: woh pitch ka parimap hai. Ab triangle par. Is triangle ki teen bhujayein hain, 4 cm, 5 cm aur 6 cm. Ek kone par ungli rakho aur kinaare par chalao: pehli bhuja, doosri, teesri, aur wapas usi kone par. Ungli jitna chali, wahi parimap hai. Ungli kone se chal ke wapas usi kone tak kul kitne cm chali?
director.card: Ungli kone se chal ke wapas usi kone tak kul kitne cm chali?

seams.form: Yahi sabse seedha tareeka hai jo mere paas hai, koi baat nahi.

director.text: 9 cm

9 cm sahi nahi hai. Ise alag tareeke se dekhte hain. Khet ke kone P par ungli rakho, aur har bhuja ka naam lekar uski lambai jodo. Jod tab poora, jab ungli wapas P par ho. Khet PQRST: PQ 8 m, QR 5 m, RS 7 m, ST 6 m, TP 3 m. Poora kinaara kitne metre ka hai?
director.card: Khet PQRST: PQ 8 m, QR 5 m, RS 7 m, ST 6 m, TP 3 m. Poora kinaara kitne metre ka hai?

seams.form: Ise alag tareeke se dekhte hain.

director.text: thoda hindi mein samjhao

Theek hai, yahi baat seedhe tareeke se kehti hoon. P se shuru karo aur PQ, QR, RS, ST, TP bolte jao. TP ke baad tum wapas P par ho. 8 m, 5 m, 7 m, 6 m aur 3 m bhujaon wale khet PQRST ka poora kinaara kitne metre ka hai?
director.card: Khet PQRST: PQ 8 m, QR 5 m, RS 7 m, ST 6 m, TP 3 m. Poora kinaara kitne metre ka hai?

seams.form: Theek hai, yahi baat seedhe tareeke se kehti hoon.

director.text: Nahi, yeh theek nahi hai. Is sawaal ka jawab 29 m hai, kyunki P se wapas P tak paanchon bhujayein: 8 + 5 + 7 + 6 + 3 = 29 m. Yeh hissa saaf hua?
samajh nahi aaya
Aasaan jodiyan pehle: 8 + 5 = 13 aur 7 + 3 = 10, toh 23; phir ST ke 6 jodo, 29 m. Yahan tak theek hai?
drawing karke samjhao
Yeh lo, isi cheez ki ek aur tasveer, ise dhyan se dekho. Ab tak samajh aaya?
pata nahi, aap batao

Main ise aur aasaan nahi bol paa rahi, koi baat nahi. Is tarah ka hisaab dobara milega, abhi pehle wale sawaal par wapas chalo. Is triangle ki bhujayein 4 cm, 5 cm aur 6 cm hain; iska parimap kitna hai?
director.card: Ungli kone se chal ke wapas usi kone tak kul kitne cm chali?

seams.form: Main ise aur aasaan nahi bol paa rahi, koi baat nahi.

director.text: 9 cm
9 cm sahi nahi hai. Board par triangle ki har bhuja par uska naap likha hai. Ungli jin bhujaon se guzri, un sabke naap milakar socho. Ab phir se socho, jawab kya hoga?
director.card: Ungli kone se chal ke wapas usi kone tak kul kitne cm chali?

director.text: ruko, main khud karti hoon
Haan, pehle tum try karo. Toh suno, sawaal yeh hai. Ungli kone se chal ke wapas usi kone tak kul kitne cm chali?
director.card: Ungli kone se chal ke wapas usi kone tak kul kitne cm chali?

director.text: 15 centimetres

Haan, sahi hai: 4 + 5 + 6 = 15 cm, teeno bhujayein judi, koi nahi chhooti. Yeh hexagon hai, chhah bhujaon wala. Sab bhujayein barabar hain, par label sirf ek par hai: 5 cm. Baaki par kuch likha nahi, phir bhi woh kinaare mein aati hain. Parimap mein har bhuja aati hai, likhi ho ya na ho. Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?
director.card: Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?

director.text: 30 centimetres

Bilkul sahi, kyunki chhah bhujayein, har ek 5 cm ki: 6 × 5 = 30 cm. Ab yeh rectangle dekho, 6 cm lamba aur 4 cm chauda. Parimap ek dhaaga hai jo kinaare par chalta hai: pehle 6, phir bagal ki bhuja 4, phir 6, phir 4. Andar ki jagah area hai, woh bilkul alag cheez hai. Kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lapetna hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?
director.card: Kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lapetna hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?

director.text: mujhe lagta hai 20 cm

Haan, bilkul theek. Dekho, dhaaga sirf kinaare par chalta hai: 6 + 4 + 6 + 4 = 20 cm. Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum dono saath mein karte hain. Maali ke paas 35 m baad hai. Phoolon ki kyari triangle jaisi hai, bhujayein 8 m, 9 m aur 14 m. Kinaare-kinaare ek baar baad lagani hai. Baad kin bhujaon par lagegi: sirf do par, ya teeno par?

seams.form: Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum dono saath mein karte hain.

director.text: mujhe nahi pata

Baad kinaare par lagti hai, toh har bhuja par lagegi: teeno par: 8 m, 9 m aur 14 m, kyunki ek bhi bhuja chhooti toh wahan khaali jagah reh jaayegi. Ab jod lo: 8 + 9 + 14 = 31 m, kyunki kyari ke poore kinaare par itni baad lagegi. Tumhari baari: maali ki 35 m baad mein se kitni bachegi?
director.card: Tumhari baari: maali ki 35 m baad mein se kitni bachegi?

director.text: pata nahi, aap batao
35 m mein se jitni baad kyari par lag gayi, utni hata do; jo reh gayi, wahi bachi. Kyari par 31 m baad lagi; maali ki 35 m mein se kitni bachegi?
director.card: Tumhari baari: maali ki 35 m baad mein se kitni bachegi?

director.text: 4 m hai na

Haan, sahi hai: baad teeno bhujaon par lagti hai, ek bhi bhuja chhoot nahi sakti. Toh poora jawab: kyari par 31 m baad lagi, aur 4 m bachi. Ek park ki chaar bhujayein alag-alag lambai ki hain. Ek kone se ghoomo toh: 9 m, 6 m, 7 m aur 4 m. Usi kone par wapas pahunchne tak kitne metre chaloge?
director.card: Ek park ki chaar bhujayein alag-alag lambai ki hain. Ek kone se ghoomo toh: 9 m, 6 m, 7 m aur 4 m. Usi kone par wapas pahunchne tak kitne metre chaloge?

director.text: mujhe lagta hai 26 m
Bilkul sahi, kyunki chaaron bhujayein judti hain: 9 + 6 + 7 + 4 = 26 m. Zoya ne 10 cm lambe, 4 cm chaude card ka parimap 10 × 4 = 40 cm nikala. Sahi parimap kitne centimetre hai?
director.card: Zoya ne 10 cm lambe, 4 cm chaude card ka parimap 10 × 4 = 40 cm nikala. Sahi parimap kitne centimetre hai?

director.text: Haan, bilkul theek. Dekho, parimap kinaara hai: 10 + 4 + 10 + 4 = 28 cm; 10 × 4 andar ki jagah hai. Seedhi bhujaon wali har shape mein har bhuja jodna chalta hai. Ab ek rectangle socho: iski bhujayein jodiyon mein aati hain, aur isse jodne ka ek jaldi wala tareeka milta hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
aapko virat pasand hai?
Main AI teacher hoon, isliye meri apni koi pasand nahi hoti. Tumhe Virat ke baare mein sabse achha kya lagta hai?
chauka

Achha, toh tumhe chauka sabse achha lagta hai. Toh ab hum wahin se aage badhte hain. Is rectangle ki do lambi bhujayein 10 m ki hain, woh lambai hai. Do chhoti bhujayein 6 m ki, woh chaudai. Aamne-saamne ki bhujayein barabar hoti hain. 10 aur 6 ek-ek baar likhe hain, par chakkar lagao toh dono do-do baar milte hain. Ek poora chakkar kitne metre ka hua?
director.card: Ek poora chakkar kitne metre ka hua?

seams.form: Toh ab hum wahin se aage badhte hain.

j2.line: Achha, toh tumhe chauka sabse achha lagta hai.

director.text: Haan, sahi hai: 10 aur 6 dono do-do baar aate hain. Naya rectangle: 12 m lamba, 5 m chauda. Neeche baayein kone se chalo, 12 m aage, phir 5 m upar. Ab tum saamne wale kone par ho, yaani aadha chakkar. Baaki aadha bhi utna hi lamba hai. Isliye parimap = 2 × (lambai + chaudai). Is rectangle ke liye 2 × (lambai + chaudai) kitna banta hai?
director.card: Is rectangle ke liye 2 × (lambai + chaudai) kitna banta hai?

director.text: 17 m sahi nahi hai. Ek doosri tarah se samajhte hain. Socho, ek cheenti khet ke kone se chalti hai. Lambai, phir chaudai chali: ab saamne wale kone par, bas aadha chakkar. Shuru wala kona abhi do bhujayein door hai. Cheenti 19 m lambe aur 8 m chaude khet ka ek poora chakkar lagati hai. Woh kul kitne metre chali?
director.card: Cheenti 19 m lambe aur 8 m chaude khet ka ek poora chakkar lagati hai. Woh kul kitne metre chali?

seams.form: Ek doosri tarah se samajhte hain.

director.text: 27 m nahi, yeh jawab theek nahi baitha. Board par dekho, cheenti ka poora chakkar kin bhujaon se banta hai; phir unki lambai jodo. 19 m lambe, 8 m chaude khet ka chakkar poora karke cheenti shuru wale kone par lauti; woh kul kitne metre chali?
director.card: Cheenti 19 m lambe aur 8 m chaude khet ka ek poora chakkar lagati hai. Woh kul kitne metre chali?

director.text: mujhe lagta hai 54 m
Bilkul sahi: do lambai aur do chaudai: 19 + 8 + 19 + 8 = 54 m. Achha, ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain. Is rectangle ke liye 2 × (lambai + chaudai) kitna banta hai?
director.card: Is rectangle ke liye 2 × (lambai + chaudai) kitna banta hai?

seams.form: Achha, ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain.

director.text: 34 m hai na

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki aadha chakkar 12 + 5 = 17 m, aur uska do guna: 2 × 17 = 34 m. Square ki chaaron bhujayein barabar hoti hain, yahan har ek 6 cm. 6 ko chaar baar jodne se achha, seedha 4 × bhuja. Jawab kinaare ka naap hai, toh centimetre mein aayega, square centimetre mein nahi. Ek bhuja 6 cm hai, toh chaaron bhujayein milkar kitne cm hain?
director.card: Ek bhuja 6 cm hai, toh chaaron bhujayein milkar kitne cm hain?

director.text: 24 centimetres

Haan, sahi hai. Dekho, chaar bhujayein, har ek 6 cm: 4 × 6 = 24 cm, kinaare ka naap hai isliye cm. Ab ek sawaal milkar, kadam-kadam hal karte hain. Ek notebook ka cover rectangle hai, 24 cm lamba aur 18 cm chauda. Uske kinaare par ek baar tape lagani hai. Kone se saamne wale kone tak, aadhe chakkar mein kaun si bhujayein aati hain?

seams.form: Ab ek sawaal milkar, kadam-kadam hal karte hain.

director.text: thak gayi, bye
Thak jaana theek hai; thoda aaram karo aur paani pi lo. Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milte hain.
